# 0.4.12

## 本次更新

- 重构登录事务生命周期：每次打开登录页都会终结旧 OAuth 事务并新建 PKCE 流程，旧的 `isLoggingIn` 状态和旧回调不会阻塞新登录；旧账号加载也不能在登出后把状态改回 signedIn。
- 登录成功统一由 AuthController 收敛：OAuth token 写入、全局 `signedIn` 状态、网页 Cookie 服务端验证同步完成后，设置/每日精选/关注/收藏/通知等依赖账号的页面才更新，并自动重新拉取数据。
- 首页个性化推荐继续使用服务端三态验证：匿名/过期 Cookie 提示登录更新 Cookie，WAF 与网络异常进入 unavailable 退避，不误判为匿名。
- 显式登出后记录 `signedOut` 证据，即使 token 清理失败，下次冷启动也不会复活旧登录。

- Rebuilds the login transaction lifecycle: every login screen visit cancels stale OAuth state and starts a fresh PKCE flow; stale callbacks and account loads cannot resurrect a signed-in state after logout.
- OAuth success converges through AuthController so Settings, Daily, Watched, Favourites and Notifications all observe the same signed-in state and refetch their data.
- Personalized home recommendations keep the server-side three-state check: anonymous/expired cookies prompt a login and cookie refresh, while WAF/network failures back off as unavailable instead of being misread as anonymous.
- Explicit logout records signed-out evidence so a leftover token cannot revive sign-in on the next cold start.
